blocking_defects.defect: NA-1 missing source-bound native action registration. cinema_proof refused the native hero proof ('directed principal action needs its unique complete current scene') because scripts/cinema_cache.py principal_event raises when a directed-film-v2 scene has fewer than 3 visual_events, and sample_frames must take three distinct native samples (first, middle, last) across each scene's complete admitted event span to measure principal occupancy and visible action. In out/dispatch/storyboard.json, scenes s1, s2, s4, s5, s6, s7 and s8 each register only 2 source-bound visual_events (only s3 has 3), so native proof can't sample or measure them. Each of those scenes needs a third genuinely performed, source-bound event inside its own clause and shot; padding or a label alone does not meet the floor.

category_reasoning: Mandatory minimum-action registration floor, not creative and not one of the seven technical-repair categories. The technical-integrity accounting has no category for a missing native action registration, so this correction counts under the mandatory code route.
third_event_requirements: Each new event needs a visible change performed by renderer code on the film clock, the scene's own source-bound narration_id with clause fractions inside the same shot, a distinct event id and time window, item_ids bound to real plane items, and matching attention_beats, registry narration views and story_art action_uses where applicable.
